name: Yellow Mustard
siboNotes: Yellow mustard is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated in typical serving sizes for most SIBO patients.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels for added garlic or onion powder
Choose brands with simple ingredients: mustard seeds, vinegar, water, salt
Store opened mustard in refrigerator for best flavor retention
Use as a base for low-FODMAP marinades and dressings
nutritionalHighlights: Low in calories (about 3 calories per teaspoon)
Provides small amounts of magnesium and phosphorus
